resolutions.applied: 本机已离线。发送将排队等待。 / 无法连接Local Operator服务器。发送将排队等待。
resolutions.judgement: Applied to both keys. 排队等待 was the group's one calque (发送将等待); the strip now uses the locale's queued verb, and the 将/已 pair (发送将排队等待 vs 消息已排队等待 in degraded) keeps EN's own distinction between 'Sending will wait' and 'Your messages are queued' while the queue itself is named the same way in both rows. Weighed and not filed: the zh is one step more concrete than EN's bare 'wait', but the promise is the same one EN makes (the send waits, it is not lost), and the two rows that say it are the two where nothing can be delivered yet. The subjects stay correct — 本机 for 'this machine' (shipped: 本机：…, 本机的…), Local Operator untouched and unspaced per the guide.
resolutions.checked: degraded sibling 消息已排队等待; state vocabulary read in chat-status.ts (internet-offline vs degraded are distinct root causes).
